kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنحصر (form VII)
# أَنْحَصِرُ (ʔanḥaṣiru) /ʔan.ħa.sˤi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
# أَنْحَصِرَ (ʔanḥaṣira) /ʔan.ħa.sˤi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
# أَنْحَصِرْ (ʔanḥaṣir) /ʔan.ħa.sˤir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
